method: Static facts, Rizin control-flow/call-site review, byte comparison, PE resource extraction, CRC-checked AutoIt extraction, and bounded UPX stub emulation. No sample application was run.
external_evidence: The three user-supplied tria.ge reports were inaccessible. Verdicts rest on local code, not ML scores or sandbox labels.

evidence: Both outer .text virtual extents (file 0x1000..0x289a) are identical. Differences are padding, bound-IAT bytes and unused data; each sample was scanned and its facts inspected independently.
Entry 0x402674 reaches WinMain-like dispatch at 0x401cb0. Configuration at 0x404120 is 3, selecting the Active Setup branch at 0x401f75: calls 0x401900 and cleanup 0x401390.

0x401900 constructs SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\<GUID>, creates the HKLM key, and writes REG_EXPAND_SZ StubPath at 0x401a4b. It reads its own module through CRT file I/O, changes configuration bytes, writes a copy and starts that copy at 0x401b7e.
0x401390 gets the current module path, converts it to a short path, obtains COMSPEC, builds /c del <self> > nul, and calls CreateProcessA at 0x4014b8, followed by ResumeThread.

Alternate installation mode 1: 0x401e47 extracts DLL resource 101 via 0x402460; its helper 0x4023c0 writes resource bytes with CreateFileA/WriteFile. 0x401260 opens LanmanServer\Parameters, deletes ServiceDLL and writes the replacement REG_EXPAND_SZ at 0x40133e.

0x401150 creates a process, allocates its memory, copies the DLL path with WriteProcessMemory, resolves Kernel32!LoadLibraryA through GetModuleHandleA/GetProcAddress, and passes that address and the remote buffer to CreateRemoteThread at 0x40123d. This is execution transfer, not merely imported APIs.

Both DLL resources at file 0x5060, length 0x9c00, are identical (sha256 0df2765cead245e3a89f9fafbbe5eb42ec7d41386a6c6dc235827539171335fd). Most code/import data was zeroed; its entry RVA 0x741a leads to zero bytes. Storm DNS and STORM command-format banners remain. Do not claim an operational DDoS payload, credential theft, Remcos or ransomware.
No string obfuscation was established in these loaders. Percent-decoded facts derive from printf GUID format specifiers, not a hidden network URL.

samples.identification: AutoIt fixed/removable-drive folder-impersonation worm (local KillFiles signature)
evidence: Native entry 0x4b8e70 is an actual UPX i386 decompressor. Stock upx -d rejects the modified headers. Unicorn emulation was bounded to decompression and branch repair, stopping at 0x4b8f8e before import resolution or application execution; recovered runtime bytes include AutoIt and EA06 references.

autoit_ripper.extract(original_bytes) decrypts and decompresses the EA06 record at file 0x49e10 and recovers a 7784-byte script.au3. The decoder checks the compressed record CRC. No application, network or OS calls were executed.

Module startup calls OPEN(), enumerates fixed drives, then loops through PROTECT(), FAKE() and COPYU(). COPYU() enumerates removable drives. FAKE() enumerates drive-root entries, selects directories, calls COPY(@ScriptFullPath, directory-path & ".exe", 0), deletes same-stem .scr files if present, and applies +RSH attributes to the real folders. COPY() reads its source, writes the destination and appends random data, changing copied-file hashes.

OPEN() opens the real folder through explorer.exe when launched from a folder impersonation copy. It installs and runs itself as Windows\svhost.exe and limits processing to that selected process path. The display deception and drive propagation support a malicious judgment independently of packaging or family labels.

PROTECT() obtains the active window title, compares it with security-related terms read from Driver.db (including antivirus brands), closes matching windows, and disables Task Manager controls, including &End Process and the process list. It writes Explorer HideFileExt/SuperHidden/ShowSuperHidden settings to conceal executable extensions and hidden folders.

The recovered OPEN() listing contains an extra closing parenthesis after a Run() expression. Successful live execution was not established. The malicious propagation, deception and interference are explicit in the recovered program; no claim of a working exploit, miner, Cobalt Strike, IcedID or njRAT is justified.

Appended randomly named PE sections carry Chromium fragments but have no memory access bits. The PE-looking child at 0x4b41f contains these fragments in its overlay; it is not independently evidence of Chromium obfuscation. The tightened decoy matcher fires on the outer inaccessible sections only.
samples.marker_content: KillFiles AutoIt worm: constrain decoys; remove UPX overclaim

changes: Preserved the verified StormAttack loader behavior traits; the two target samples still have four hostile and one suspicious trait each.

Moved seven ordinary Chromium references into neutral URL, UI, telemetry and build-debug homes. Moved the elevation-service source path to build-debug metadata. Matchers, file-type scopes and platforms are preserved; descriptions now say reference where appropriate.

Replaced Chromium-string co-occurrence with a PE-aware rule requiring three distinct markers actually contained in inaccessible raw sections. The removed chromium-junk-strings component had no external exact consumers and supplied no independent concealment evidence.

Moved the early-UPX-magic and UPX-section-without-early-magic observations to metadata/binary/layout/stub; retained their conditions and all exact consumers. Promoted the complete early packing-magic observation from component to notable. Removed the generic hostile API-resolving UPX profile: ordinary decompression/API resolution/page protection cannot establish hostile intent.

Removed two capability downgrades that depended on the old objectives/junking directory (LevelDB and WebSocket), avoiding illegal capability-to-objective dependencies and loss of neutral capability evidence. An ancestor anti-analysis string selector now receives only actual concealment observations.

Added a generalizable source-level suspicious trait for AutoIt disabling Task Manager process termination, bound to a direct ControlDisable call and the specific window/control. It excludes commented calls and unrelated windows. Encrypted EA06 needs extraction before this new source-level rule can fire.
The AutoIt sample retains two verified hostile worm/family findings plus one suspicious inaccessible-section stuffing finding; the embedded PE-looking child has no hostile or suspicious findings.

placement_audit.exact_references: All relocated exact IDs and local-ID consumers updated, including UPX variants and cross-tier metadata consumers.
placement_audit.ancestor_selectors: Audited objectives/anti-static/pack/upx, objectives/anti-static/obfuscation/string/junking and their ancestors, plus objectives/evasion/masquerade/debug and ancestors. No moved reference is silently added to an unrelated objective; capability downgrades corrected as described.

validation: Run make validate as the final action after markers and rescans; if it reports only a stale inline-YARA cache fingerprint, precompile and validate again.
